item.title: Microsoft Study Finds AI Coding Patches 2.33x Larger Than Human Fixes
item.description:
A new Microsoft paper replayed 7,660 GitHub Copilot CLI runs across 18 models, traced each patch block to its originating step, and re-ran tests to grade necessity. Agent patches touch 2.33x more lines than human fixes, but the surplus is mostly tests and documentation rather than redundant code. On SWE-bench Verified, 88.7% of agent code blocks were needed versus 86.4% for developers, suggesting over-editing stems from the fix itself, not debug leftovers; the authors urge reporting needed-code share alongside resolve rate.

原文标题：微软新研究揭示 AI 编程补丁体积达人类 2.33 倍

Why it matters：首次用逐块溯源与重跑测试的方法量化 AI 补丁“体积大但必要”的现象，为编程智能体评测提供了新指标。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 74/100

item.title: Aschenbrenner's AI Hedge Fund Sheds 65% in Third Quarter
item.description:
Situational Awareness, the AI-focused hedge fund founded by Leopold Aschenbrenner, told investors it lost 65% after fees in Q3 2026, with most of the damage in July when a brief AI panic triggered bank margin calls on its leveraged bets. The fund sold the bulk of its public stocks to Ken Griffin's Citadel at a discount to raise cash, cutting its 2026 gain to 88.5% through September from a reported 439% through June.

原文标题：Aschenbrenner 旗下 AI 对冲基金三季度回撤 65%

Why it matters：这是 AI 主题投资高杠杆风险的一次标志性回撤案例，对判断 AI 资本市场情绪具有参考价值。

The integration also connects to Jianying Hub, turning scripts, code or product images into explainer animations and short-form videos.

item.title: Terence Tao Warns AI-Generated Math Proofs Risk Becoming Nuclear Waste
item.description:
Speaking at a Harvard event, Terence Tao said AI companies mass-produce hard-to-digest math proofs to benchmark models, likening the output to nuclear waste from power plants, and urged firms to co-select problems with mathematicians. He is himself following and interpreting the newly announced Riemann Hypothesis proof, launched a public collaboration on his blog to digest it, and said he has handed Python, JavaScript and literature search to AI while keeping independent mathematical reasoning for himself.

原文标题：陶哲轩谈 AI 数学证明：批量产出如同核废料

Why it matters：顶尖数学家对 AI 生成数学证明质量与生态影响的一手判断，兼具观点价值与行业信号。

item.title: China Statistics Bureau Says AI Data Center Buildout Lifts Fiber Optic Profits 6.7x
item.description:
China's National Bureau of Statistics reported that large-scale AI data center construction drove profits in fiber optic and optical cable manufacturing up 6.7x and 1.5x respectively for January-October. The electronics sector's profits doubled year-on-year, contributing 9.7 percentage points to overall industrial profit growth, with AI compute demand also lifting memory chips and base metals like copper and aluminum.

原文标题：国家统计局：智算中心建设带动光纤制造利润增长 6.7 倍

Why it matters：官方宏观数据首次量化智算中心建设对光纤光缆、电子与有色金属产业链的利润拉动，是观察 AI 算力投资外溢效应的硬指标。

item.description:

He argues that containment must precede genuine alignment, making safety and alignment research the top priority.

item.title: Amazon Paper Finds Self-Revised Agent Harnesses Barely Generalize
item.description:
A new Amazon paper finds that frontier models can build their own agent harnesses from scratch, but self-revisions yield little on unseen tasks. Across 9 model setups with 3 builds and 2 self-revisions each, practice-game scores rose 8.42 points while unseen-game gains were only 2.80, too uncertain to rule out zero. In 9 of 27 runs, cheaper versions also scored worse.

原文标题：亚马逊论文揭示智能体自改框架泛化增益微弱

Why it matters：首次系统量化智能体自我改写框架的泛化边界，对自动化智能体工程实践有直接警示价值。

item.title: Twenty AI Agents Team Up to Cut Quickwit Query Time by 31%
item.description:
TabbyML assembled 20 AI agents into an autonomous engineering team that optimized the open-source search engine Quickwit without being told which code to change, handling bottleneck discovery, solution design and peer code review on its own. In four days the team ran roughly 350 experiments and kept 6 reviewed optimizations, cutting total hot-query time on a 100M-row dataset from 40.5s to 27.9s, with some queries dropping 87%, and surpassing all prior public results in the ClickBench data-lake hot-query category.

原文标题：20 个 AI Agents 组队 4 天优化 Quickwit 查询降 31%

Why it matters：这是多智能体自主完成真实系统性能优化的完整闭环案例，含可验证基准与量化收益，对关注 Agent 工程化落地的读者价值高。

item.description:

item.description:
Kuaishou has dissolved its standalone Local Services business unit, splitting it into its e-commerce and commercialization divisions alongside staff cuts. Launched as an independent unit in 2022, the business posted rapid GMV growth in 2023-2024, but a 2025 shift from merchant subsidies to ad-spend promotion and the end of separate data disclosure signaled a strategic downgrade.

item.title: NVIDIA Paper Finds Self-Compacting Context Nearly Triples Model Scores
item.description:
An NVIDIA paper introduces NOOA, an open-source agent framework that gives models an API to summarize chosen history segments and retrieve originals later, nearly tripling GPT-6.1 Sol's score on OfficeQA Pro v2 from 21% to 56% at a 32K budget. Results vary sharply across models: Claude Opus 5.5 used the API in only 4% of tasks, while Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4 Pro compacted prematurely without timing hints. The takeaway is to let strong models manage their own context under tight budgets, but validate per model first.

原文标题：英伟达新论文称模型自主压缩上下文可提升近三倍得分

Why it matters：首次系统对比模型自主压缩与框架自动压缩上下文，并给出跨模型差异的量化证据，对智能体开发者有直接指导价值。

item.title: DeepSeek Tests Per-Turn Cost Display for Chat Users
item.description:
DeepSeek is A/B testing a per-turn cost display in its web and mobile chat apps, showing token usage and an API-equivalent estimated price after each exchange, plus a context-window occupancy indicator. The feature makes the inference cost behind free consumer chat visible and highlights that cache-hit input is priced at one-fiftieth of cache-miss input.

原文标题：DeepSeek 灰度测试对话成本可视化功能

Why it matters：头部开源模型厂商首次把单轮推理成本透明化给 C 端用户，是观察大模型商业化与成本结构的一手信号。

He stressed the lab remains far from full recursive self-improvement, and that agents' chain-of-thought is deliberately not rewarded during training so their intentions stay reviewable in natural language before acting.

item.title: Anthropic Finds 14 of 23 Unlearned Models Still Recall Cyberattack Facts
item.description:
Anthropic researchers found that 14 of 23 models trained to unlearn cyberattack knowledge still ranked the correct answers first, indicating post-hoc unlearning fails to reliably remove hazardous facts. The authors argue that because facts are recalled through neurons shared across many topics, post-training unlearning may never generalize, and dangerous knowledge may need to be isolated during training instead.

原文标题：Anthropic 发现 23 个遗忘模型有 14 个仍记得攻击知识

Why it matters：该研究直接质疑当前主流机器遗忘范式的有效性，对 AI 安全与模型对齐路线具有实质影响。

After the fix, Astra users hit usage limits 40% faster and Sol users 25% faster for the same workload, but OpenAI will not retroactively bill the shortfall and is granting Go, Plus, Pro and Business users one bankable quota reset as compensation.

The move comes despite 13% year-over-year Q3 revenue growth and is seen as CEO Christian Klein reallocating resources behind an AI-first strategy that embeds generative AI and agents into enterprise software.

item.title: shadcn Unveils UI SDK Turning Components into Agent Primitives

This lets agents compose and reuse the same interaction capabilities across React, Vue, Svelte and Solid.

item.title: OpenAI GPT-Live-1.1 登顶语音基准 自然度 999 Elo
item.description:
OpenAI 的 GPT-Live-1.1 在 Voice Arena 的 Jarvis Bench 总榜登顶，自然度 Elo 达 999、感知任务有效性 1025，并以 GPT 6.2 Sol Medium 作为后端在实时航司预订任务上取得 100% 成功率。但人类评分者仍更偏好真人坐席（1288 分），且在通话处理观感上 Gemini 3.8 Live 得分更高，显示语音自然度、通话体验与后端任务完成度三者并不同步。

item.title: 华盛顿大学与微软提出 DualPM 双轨经验学习法
item.description:
华盛顿大学与微软联合论文提出 DualPM 方法，让智能体在每次任务后分别沉淀成功与失败两类经验，并每 20 个任务合并为两个有上限的经验列表。在 GPT-5.5 上测试 720 个多领域工具调用任务显示，失败经验将所需工具发现率从 75.2% 提升至 81.0%，成功经验将交互轮次从 6.1 降至 5.4，两者合用使答案准确率从 68.1% 升至 73.2%。结论是失败经验拓宽工具搜索范围，成功经验提升执行效率，成本敏感场景可仅用成功经验。

Why it matters：首次系统区分失败与成功经验在智能体自我改进中的不同作用，并给出可复现的量化收益。

item.title: 蚂蚁集团开源 LingBot-Navi 导航模型 让机器人拥有空间记忆
item.description:
蚂蚁集团旗下具身智能公司 Robbyant 开源了导航模型 LingBot-Navi，核心创新是让机器人在跨任务中保留空间记忆，在同一环境中工作越久速度越快。该模型无需预先建图，在探索过程中自建包含布局、物体位置与可通行路径的 3D 记忆，并将 3D 表面位置与视觉语言特征配对，从而定位视野外的目标。系统由场景级规划器负责在记忆地图上预测路线，局部规划器负责避障与到达判断。

Why it matters：开源视觉语言导航模型引入跨任务空间记忆，直击具身智能中重复探索的痛点，具备明确的工程复用价值。

英伟达已要求戴尔、超微等制造合作伙伴暂停向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印度尼西亚发运服务器，以评估当地伙伴是否满足美国出口管制要求。此举针对中国企业通过东南亚数据中心远程调用英伟达芯片的漏洞，美国商务部本月已收紧相关规则；据智库估算，这类远程算力约占中国 AI 算力的 24%。
